csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEditor; using System.Text; public class PlayerAnalysis { public static string Execute() { GameObject player = GameObject.Find("Player_Test01"); if (player == null) return "Player_Test01 not found in scene."; StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(); sb.AppendLine($"--- Analysis for {player.name} ---"); var presenter = player.GetComponent<PlayerPresenter>(); if (presenter != null) { sb.AppendLine($"[Presenter] HasLocalControl: {presenter.GetType().GetProperty("HasLocalControl", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).GetValue(presenter)}"); var rbField = presenter.GetType().GetField("_rigidbody3D", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance); sb.AppendLine($"[Presenter] _rigidbody3D assigned: {rbField?.GetValue(presenter) != null}"); } var rb = player.GetComponent<Rigidbody>(); if (rb != null) { sb.AppendLine($"[Rigidbody] isKinematic: {rb.isKinematic}"); sb.AppendLine($"[Rigidbody] constraints: {rb.constraints}"); sb.AppendLine($"[Rigidbody] useGravity: {rb.useGravity}"); } var pv = player.GetComponent<PhotonView>(); if (pv != null) { sb.AppendLine($"[PhotonView] IsMine: {pv.IsMine}"); sb.AppendLine($"[PhotonView] ViewID: {pv.viewID}"); } var controller = player.GetComponentInChildren<Controller>(); if (controller != null) { sb.AppendLine($"[Controller] Found: Yes"); } else { sb.AppendLine($"[Controller] Found: No (Check if assigned in Presenter)"); } return sb.ToString(); } }
